# Reflect method lookup must keep the target method reachable at every
# -O level. -O=3 raises the inliner budget enough to inline
# reflect.Value.Method into the caller, erasing the call the linker
# reachability mark depends on and pruning the method.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

go build -O=0 -o $WORK/r0 .
exec $WORK/r0
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/r0
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/r0
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'

go build -O=1 -o $WORK/r1 .
exec $WORK/r1
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/r1
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/r1
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'

go build -O=2 -o $WORK/r2 .
exec $WORK/r2
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/r2
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/r2
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'

go build -O=3 -o $WORK/r3 .
exec $WORK/r3
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/r3
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/r3
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'

go build -O=s -o $WORK/rs .
exec $WORK/rs
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/rs
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'
exec $WORK/rs
stdout 'called'
stdout 'ok'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/reflectmethod

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
)

type M int

func (m M) UniqueMethodName() {
	fmt.Println("called")
}

func main() {
	reflect.ValueOf(M(0)).Method(0).Interface().(func())()
	fmt.Println("ok")
}
